scope: Read-only supplied-source review; no model tool actions or delegated edits

findings.finding: P1 shutdown resumes held channel work before cursor mutation
findings.disposition: Confirmed and fixed independently while review ran. Gate assertAdmission rechecks host restore/shutdown before work(); Telegram shutdown cursor regression test passes.

findings.finding: P2 dispatch lifetime is shorter than model turn
findings.disposition: Quiet-workspace admission is deliberate. assertPrivateBackupIdle rejects an already busy bot or job before pause and rechecks after handler drain; no claim that snapshot waits for an entire model turn. Keep full v2 writer-lifetime review as integration gate.

findings.finding: P2 Discord ACK/channel timestamp is ungated
findings.disposition: Not a portable business snapshot writer: channel-discord.json is excluded from filesAt/capture. Keep transport ACK responsive; actual Desk decision is gated and fingerprint/pairing revalidated. Source comment added.

findings.finding: P2 background batch recovery / remote flush / office link
findings.disposition: Confirmed narrower batch recovery race: parent batch status is paused while waiting for readiness (no queued parent status). Added reversible canRecover before and after awaited readiness; test preserves bytes and attempts, then resumes. Terminal BatchService.stop must not be used. Remote flush and office heartbeat write excluded auxiliary files.

Gate is admission/drain, not a global worker mutex. Telegram and Slack polling await their handler; socket events can overlap and require a separate durable arrival/dispatch audit. No FIFO or exactly-once delivery claim for a socket process crash.
